structured_output.what_is_happening: GHOSTGUY (7UQ8…ZzWv) looks like a copycat of an older, larger "Just a ghost guy" token. The older one, EGRv…pump, is a pump.fun launch that has already graduated. It came out about 55 minutes before this one and sits at ~$84-88k market cap with ~$580k in 24h volume. It uses the same X handle, @GhostguyOnSol, which DexScreener lists on it. This token was created directly as a PumpSwap pool at 21:44 UTC (creation time and pair time match, no bonding curve). Its LP is 100% unlocked and the creator has closed its position. It ran +74% within its first hour on heavy buy counts (1,820 unique buyers vs 102 sellers), then fell ~33% in the last 5 minutes, while the original also dropped ~34% over the same 5 minutes.

narrative.description: 'Just a ghost guy' meme, apparently in the style of 'just a chill guy'. The attention is on the original EGRv…pump token (+1,297% on its pump.fun pair). I couldn't find any wider cultural event behind it.
narrative.why_spreading: A short-lived pump.fun meme, and it is the original token that is running. This contract seems to catch spillover buys from people and bots who search by the ticker.

token_connection.why_this_token: Same name and ticker, but it launched about 55 minutes after the original and outside pump.fun. The project X handle shows up on GeckoTerminal for this pair, but DexScreener ties that handle to the EGRv…pump token.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN shows no snipers, bundlers or smart money. But a 20-minute-old copycat with 1,820 unique buyers and only 102 sellers suggests bots or confused buyers going after the ticker. There is no paid promotion. One wallet (not flagged as insider) holds 17.4%.
authenticity.uncertainty: Web search found nothing on X, and I couldn't fetch the X account (HTTP 402), so I can't see who is actually calling this contract.

structural_risks: LP is 100% unlocked on a pool created directly on PumpSwap, so whoever deployed it can pull liquidity
It is a copycat of a larger original, and attention sits with the original
Price is down 33% in the last 5 minutes, with the original falling in step
